product_metadata.title: Hoxierence 8 Inch Ceramic Salad Plates, Classic White Round Lunch Plates with Black Line Edges, Porcelain Sering Dinner Plates for Steak, Appetizers, Pasta, Salad, Home, Party, Restaurant - Set of 4
features: Ceramic Material - The salad plate is made of high-quality AB-grade porcelain clay, the high-temperature glaze firing process, durable and sturdy, free of BPA, LEAD, and CADMIUM.
Elegant Design - White dinner plates feature black rim lines to outline a modern artistic sense, simple and generous. Classic designs never go out of style and fade.
Plates Specification - 8 inches in diameter, 1 inch high. Set of 4. Stackable saves your kitchen cabinet storage space. These round lunch plates are easy to match with other tableware.
Convenient & Safe - The smooth ceramic glazed surface prevents the stains from remaining/sticking, easy to clean. Can be heated to 450°F, safe for microwave, freezer, dishwasher, oven.
Multifunctional Tableware - Dinner salad plates set suitable for pasta, pizza, salad, steak, chicken, pie, grilled meat, and more. Also Ideal for festive and housewarming gifts.
